member.summary: Determines whether the specified is valid and can send in-game letters. In RimWorld, many incidents (such as raids, trader visits, resource pod crashes, and modded events like Dynamic Diplomacy) dispatch letters dynamically via their worker class rather than declaring static XML letter fields (e.g. letterDef, letterLabel). Therefore, all valid incident definitions are cataloged so players can configure their letter behaviors.
